title: is_mostly_bin is the binary heuristic but not used by contentviews
answers: How does mitmproxy decide binary vs text?
body:
`mitmproxy/utils/strutils.py:is_mostly_bin(bytes)` is the only binary/text heuristic: empty→False; inspects first ~100 bytes (cut extended up to 3 bytes to avoid splitting UTF-8 continuation bytes); low = <9 or 14–31, high = >126; if printable ASCII >70% → text; elif ascii+high >95% and `s.decode()` succeeds → text; else binary.
Gotcha: contentviews do NOT call it (grep shows no use in mitmproxy/contentviews). Callers: `tools/console/master.py` (hex editor offer), `addons/savehar.py` (base64 vs text content). Binary in views just falls to raw view (priority 0.1). A binary-grabbing view must call `strutils.is_mostly_bin` in its own `render_priority`.
`strutils.is_xml` sniffs first non-whitespace byte == '<'.
